name: mobile
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one premium website illustration for a mobile app development service, landscape 3:2 composition. Two elegant modern smartphones floating at a subtle 3/4 angle, one foreground and one behind, showing a beautifully designed fictional appointment/lifestyle app. White UI, violet #5f01fb buttons, lavender tiles, near-black typography. One screen shows a tasteful image of a modern interior, small appointment cards, calendar date selector and a violet booking button; other shows a confirmation and personal schedule. High-end product-design render, realistic glass and metallic white frame, sophisticated soft studio lighting, light lavender sculptural loop behind devices, subtle soft shadow. Background solid very pale lavender #f8f6fc, no hard floor or horizon, objects centred with generous 12% breathing room on all sides. No people, no logos, no captions outside devices, no watermark. Keep interface text minimal and clean. This is a compact hero illustration for a professional agency, refined and tangible, not a flat wireframe or generic dashboard.
